scope: Architecture and mechanism only. Proprietary corpus quantity, exclusivity, jurisdictional coverage, brand, adoption and price confer no comparison credit. The mechanisms that select, ground, validate, cite, remember, plan, coordinate, execute, inspect and evolve remain in scope.
individual_comparison_rule: E_star must strictly dominate every mandatory baseline separately on every binding mechanism axis. A union, average, composite baseline or best-of-products surrogate cannot hide a failure against one named product.

excluded_content_advantages: size or exclusivity of a proprietary legal corpus
number of covered jurisdictions or licensed publications
brand, market share, customer count or institutional prestige
price, implementation effort or elapsed study time
included_mechanism_properties: planning, coordination, memory, provenance and workflow semantics
correctness, consistency, progress, liveness, determinism, durability, recovery, performance, auditability, introspection and evolvability
two_track_evidence: MECHANISM_NORMALIZED: common public or synthetic materials, frozen tasks, calibrated tool and model envelopes, identical scoring semantics and result-blind thresholds
PRODUCT_BLACK_BOX: the actual named products on the same externally observable tasks and inputs, with every unavailable or non-comparable result recorded as UNKNOWN
normalization.no_content_substitution: A superior corpus answer cannot compensate for an inferior mechanism, and a mechanism claim cannot borrow authority from proprietary content.

axis_closure_rule: Every materially observable architecture or mechanism property of every mandatory baseline must map to exactly one frozen binding axis or receive a mechanically checked irrelevance proof. An unmapped property sets AXIS_DOMAIN_OPEN and blocks FOC-18/T6.
unknown_rule: UNKNOWN, inaccessible, unlicensed, unobserved, non-comparable, missing, null, skipped or timed-out evidence never counts as equality or superiority and blocks the commercial-superiority claim.
